name: b1-churchapps
description: Connect your church's B1 and FreePlay (ChurchApps) data to Claude.
long_description:
Lets Claude work with your church's B1 data — people, groups, attendance, giving, forms, website content, FreePlay lessons and classrooms, and more — through ChurchApps' official MCP server (https://api.churchapps.org/mcp).

You'll need a B1 API key: in B1Admin, logged in as yourself, create an API key, then paste it in this extension's settings. Claude can only do what that key allows.

api_key.title: B1 API key
api_key.description: Create one in B1Admin (logged in as yourself). Stored securely by the Claude app.
